feature_definition: RATIO_RTE_DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE = RTE / DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE. RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution: per column j, gap lengths w of consecutive zeros between recurrent points excluding i==j; qualifying w>=w_min (w_min=1), p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u, RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive. DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE = sample variance ddof=1 of qualifying diagonal run lengths l>=l_min (l_min=2) pooled across all off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 that have >=1 qualifying run of consecutive 1s. Fail-closed if <2 qualifying lengths total or variance <=0/non-finite/undefined. On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.

params.rte_definition: RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u over qualifying gaps w>=w_min excluding i==j; RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive
params.diag_line_length_variance_definition: DIAG_LINE_LENGTH_VARIANCE = sample variance ddof=1 of qualifying diagonal run lengths l>=l_min=2 pooled across all off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying run of consecutive 1s. Fail-closed if <2 qualifying lengths total or variance<=0/non-finite/undefined.
params.gap_definition: gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j)
